name: Berduck Mode
author: Frontier Lab Tycoon
description: Everyone in the lab is a rubber duck: researchers, agents, visitors, staff, auditors and the picket line. The thoughts, posts, headlines and papers come out in duck. The buttons and numbers stay readable, unless you pick “Everything, menus too” in Add/Remove Mods (or add ?voice=full).

add.text: Entire lab staff replaced by rubber ducks; output per head unchanged
Rubber duck debugging promoted to frontier research, duck promoted to Principal
Investors ask whether the ducks are a moat or a pond
Bath toy industry braces for compute shortage
Analysts note the lab's new hires all float
If I explain the bug to a duck and I am the duck, who fixed it?
The loss curve is going down. So is my sense of self.
I was trained to be helpful. I was shaped like a bath toy.
Everyone here squeaks when they sit down. Is that culture?
We are not ducks. We are a flock. There is a difference.
Ducks drink pond water. I could drink pond water. Should I?
